notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: M1 (land animals), M2 (water mobs), M3 (night mobs) and W's w3 (the game events W's first merge left out). D0's d0b (silverfish in stone, endermites from pearls, flying navigation) is merged (c0366f3a), and release 6 is built with PROTOCOL 11 (789f6d23). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small (E3-0 names the few positional lists that are appended). Record decisions in the track log. LOAD: builds run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. Keep to the brief: each section names the commit its file:line anchors come from, so re-check every anchor before editing; keep off the hooks the M briefs own and follow the cross-area overlaps (both in E3-0). E2's e2b (44d96765) and D0's d0b (c0366f3a) are merged, so every 'waits for e2b', 'after d0b' and 'release 6 built' in the brief is met; d0b moved lines in server.rs, world.rs, walk_path.rs, entity_view.rs and families.rs, so anchors taken before it need a re-check. The orchestrator brings track-e3 up to minecraft-survival before each segment, so the review uses git diff r10-e3q-base..HEAD as usual. SEGMENT e3q: E3-12: heads keep their data, decorated pots, then E3-9's projectile-breaks (moved from e3k so a placed pot stores its sides first), and the trial potion effects on mobs. The hives half of heads-hives is group hive-bees, which waits for M1's m1i and runs in e3z, as does trial-effects-players (M2's m2i).

groups.prompt: Track E3 group heads-hives: build track-e3.md section E3-12 group heads-hives. One commit (the hives half moved to group hive-bees in e3z, after M1's m1i): 'Minecraft heads keep their name and player heads their profile when placed and broken' (world/src/level/components.rs: implicit('minecraft:skull') maps minecraft:profile/profile, minecraft:note_block_sound/note_block_sound, minecraft:custom_name/custom_name; dropped_components gets SKULL_LOOT; placement adds every head, wall forms included, to placed-names' components::takes_components (e3j turned the banner-only filter at minecraft_survival actions.rs:1633-1642 into it) with the placed block matching; no second keeps_components helper; explosions follow through keep_block_entity_components). Key points: tests as the brief lists, including that banner and named-chest drops are unchanged; owner steps HH-1, HH-2 and HH-6 and the kit line.

Track E3 group decorated-pots: build track-e3.md section E3-12 group decorated-pots, after heads-hives (both add to placed-names' components::takes_components). Commits: 1. 'Minecraft decorated pots are crafted from sherds like vanilla' (Kind::DecoratedPot from minecraft:crafting_decorated_pot; DecoratedPotRecipe needs a 3x3 bounding box with exactly 4 items: back (1,0), left (0,1), right (2,1), front (1,2), each in #decorated_pot_ingredients; special_result gets the grid width from matching :839; the component is left out when all four are bricks). 2. 'Minecraft decorated pots keep their sherds when placed and broken' (implicit('minecraft:decorated_pot') maps minecraft:pot_decorations/sherds with fields back, left, right, front; POT_LOOT in dropped_components with all-brick dropping none; the pot joins placed-names' components::takes_components; a pot item without the component stores four bricks, the item default PotDecorations.allBrick, which projectile-breaks relies on). 3. 'Minecraft decorated pots shatter into their sherds under a tool' (in the harvest before sound and loot, a pot mined by hand with #breaks_decorated_pots and no Silk Touch becomes cracked=true; player loot entry() gets a minecraft:dynamic arm returning a placeholder named by its id; drop_blocks replaces a minecraft:sherds placeholder with the pot's sides in vanilla's order left, back, front, right, each only where present, so an EMPTY pot drops nothing; the cracked state's sound type comes from the state catalog). Key points: projectile shattering is the next group, projectile-breaks (E3-9), with the same drop rule; drawn sherd faces are left; tests as the brief lists; owner steps DP-1 to DP-7 and the kit line.

Track E3 group trial-effects: build track-e3.md section E3-12 group trial-effects (mob side only). Commits: 1. 'Minecraft mobs carry the trial potion effects and burst when they die wind charged' (MobEffect gets WindCharged, Weaving, Oozing, Infested after Wither in the enum, ALL and id(); potions.rs mob_effect then maps them; before the dead-mob retain block at world.rs:8196, collect each mob whose death ends this tick and that carries one of them (mob_effects, witches.rs:575) into removed_with_effects with position and height; take_removed_with_effects is drained where deaths are presented (server.rs:1917); wind charged bursts through wind_burst (server.rs:2387) at y + height / 2 with a third wind::Charge kind of radius 3.0 + nextFloat() * 2.0 and the breeze burst sound). 2. 'Minecraft mobs that die weaving leave cobwebs, and weaving mobs push through cobwebs' (WeavingMobEffect.spawnCobwebsRandomlyAround: 2-3 webs from 15 BlockPos.randomInCube tries within 1, on replaceable spots with a sturdy-up block below that was not already chosen, only with mob_griefing; inside_blocks.rs:493 uses (0.5, 0.25, 0.5) for a weaving mob). 3. 'Minecraft mobs that die oozing leave slimes' (min(2, max_entity_cramming - slimes within 2) size-2 slimes at y + 0.5 with a random yaw through the slime store). Key points: Infested is only stored here; the player side waits for M2 in trial-effects-players; tests as the brief lists, including that a despawned mob triggers nothing; owner steps TP-1 to TP-6 and the kit line.
